{{dablink|For other uses of the word "dance," see [[Dance]].}}
'''''Wavedancer''''' is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' [[raker]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wavedancer|Wavedancer}}

==Appearance==
''Wavedancer'' is one hundred [[Measurement|paces]] long and has three towering masts amidships with a shorter one on the raised deck at the stern.

==Crew==
The [[Sailmistress]] of ''Wavedancer'' is [[Coine din Jubai Wild Winds]].{{ref||Wavedancer}} The [[Windfinder]] is [[Jorin din Jubai White Wing]]. The [[Cargomaster]] is [[Toram (Atha'an Miere)|Toram]]. Also among the crew is a woman named [[Dorele]].

==Activities==
During the winter of {{ne|999}}, ''Wavedancer'' wintered on the docks in [[Tanchico]].{{ref/book|4|19}} When [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] decide that they must go to Tanchico to thwart the [[Black Ajah]]'s plans there, [[Moiraine Damodred]] suggests that they use a Sea Folk raker as they are the fastest ships.{{ref/book|4|12}} Elayne and Nynaeve find that the ''Wavedancer'' is docked at Tear and they negotiate the [[Gift of Passage]] to Tanchico. During the negotiation, [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and [[Juilin Sandar]] also request passage to Tanchico.{{ref/book|4|2}}{{ref/book|4|19}} On their way to Tanchico, ''Wavedancer'' passes through the [[Fingers of the Dragon]] into the [[Sea of Storms]].{{ref/book|4|20}} Ten days later, they arrive in Tanchico.{{ref/book|4|39}} To ease her cargomaster's loss of income because of the trip, Coine din Jubai sets sail for [[Dantora]], with eventual port calls in the [[Aile Jafar]] group, [[Cantorin]] and the [[Aile Somera]] group.{{ref/book|4|39}}{{ref/book|4|46}}
